definitions.explanation: The act of translating into English, or the resulting translated text.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{英訳|えいやく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please translate this sentence into English.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{英訳|えいやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An English translation of a Japanese novel was published.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門|せんもん}{用語|ようご}→専門用語：22120_senmonyougo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{英訳|えいやく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Translating technical terminology into English is difficult.

notes:
RELATED TRANSLATION TERMS:
- ⟦{和訳|わやく}→和訳：17845_wayaku⟧: Japanese translation (translating into Japanese)
- ⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧: translation (general term, any language pair)
- ⟦{通訳|つうやく}→通訳：03516_tsuuyaku⟧: interpretation (spoken translation)
- ⟦{直訳|ちょくやく}→直訳：13629_chokuyaku⟧: literal translation
- ⟦{意訳|いやく}→意訳：17846_iyaku⟧: free/liberal translation

USAGE:
{英訳|えいやく} specifically means translating into English. It can be used as a noun ({英訳|えいやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧, to read the English translation) or as a verb with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ({英訳|えいやく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, to translate into English).
